mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring expectations, which leads to lower near-term earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.5 over two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, indicating a supply-side shock that disrupts corporate production and raises input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising above 2.0% annually, it signals a tightening monetary policy environment that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 9.5% and a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 129,000 indicates a labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts (HOUST) above 580,000 units over two consecutive months signals strong housing demand, boosting related sectors and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 101.0 combined with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 9.5% indicates a dual stress on supply and labor markets, signaling a broad economic slowdown that reduces corporate profitability and triggers negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
